description: Condition-matched enrollment ablation showing simulated vs genuine narrowband degradation
key_finding: Genuine phone-degraded audio is 14.6% BETTER MATCHED (separation 0.5268 vs 0.4596) than ffmpeg-simulated degradation when compared against the correctly-matched centroid. This quantifies how computationally-simulated codec degradation differs from real telephony.
